query: SELECT SUM(lc.valor) as total_excluido FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN periodo_custo pc ON lc.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE pc.mes = 4 AND pc.ano = 2026 AND lc.observacoes LIKE '[Import]%' AND (UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%QMD 0H48%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%QMO6E54%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%QMD0H48%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%QMN1F10%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%SETOR RH%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%RRH 9F10%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%TNW 2I60%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%ALIMENTADOR AVS01%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%OUTROS%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%QUADRICICLO%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%PENEIRA 02 NOVA H 01%' OR UPPER(lc.observacoes) LIKE '%QUADRICICLO HONDA%');
